# SugarCRM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence positioning | sales, marketing and service platforms for medium-sized and large B2B enterprises, with emphasis on configuration processes, forecasting and deployment controls. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | 15 user start-ups and implementation services raise small team thresholds; AI, LinkedIn connectors, storage and support borders vary from version to version. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | 15 User start-up and implementation services raise small team thresholds; AI, LinkedIn connectors, storage and support borders vary from version to version. |
